title: STASIS introduces the EURS euro stablecoin in 2018
description: STASIS introduced EURS as a euro-referenced token backed by euro balances and later expanded it across multiple settlement layers with issuer redemption and reserve-verification processes.
notes: The year is supported by current official materials; a durable day-level launch date remains unresolved.

title: Tether ends direct EURT redemption
description: Tether ceased direct redemption of EURT under its terms effective 27 November 2025. The Ethereum and historical Omni token records remain relevant as on-chain history, but issuer issuance and redemption are terminated.
notes: Secondary-market trading or residual balances do not constitute restoration of Tether redemption.

title: Celo Dollar is renamed Mento Dollar and cUSD becomes USDm
description: Mento changed the asset name and ticker from Celo Dollar and cUSD to Mento Dollar and USDm. Mento stated that the peg, contracts, balances, integrations, and user requirements were unchanged.
notes: SOG treats this as one continuous asset identity rather than a migration into a new token.

title: Alchemix introduces alUSD and yield-backed borrowing
description: Alchemix introduced alUSD as a synthetic U.S. dollar debt asset minted against yield-bearing DAI collateral, with collateral yield designed to reduce debt and Transmuter or market routes supporting conversion.
notes: This date reflects the initial official introduction and launch phase rather than every later V2 or V3 deployment.
